adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts, the new cancel logic iterates calendar references and, when a reference has a credentialId, it first looks in bookingToDelete.user.credentials but then falls back to prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } }) and uses that result for getCalendar(...)/deleteEvent(...) without verifying the credential belongs to bookingToDelete.user (or team/org). This is a widened trust boundary compared to the previous behavior which effectively constrained operations to credentials present on bookingToDelete.user.credentials. If a booking reference contains an unexpected/foreign credentialId, cancellation could delete events using another user's credential.
